name: M5.Translation.shift_quotient_polynomial
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (S : Finset (ZMod N)) (c : ZMod N), AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus N) (M5.Translation.supportPolynomial (M5.Translation.shift S c)) = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus N) ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ c.val) * AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus N) (M5.Translation.supportPolynomial S)
queries: ZMod val add sub modulo injective
guidance:
Use injectivity of ZMod.val for N positive and shift injectivity to express support polynomials as sums. Canonical val(x+c) is (val x+val c)%N. Quotient monomial periodicity identifies modulo reduction, and pow_add converts the shift to multiplication by X^c.val. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact imported local API (Lean Explore only searches external libraries):
M5.Connectivity.support_gcd_dvd : ∀ (N d : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), d ∣ M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B ↔ d ∣ N ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b)
M5.SupportPolynomial.quotient_monomial_period : ∀ T a j : ℕ, AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (a + j * T)) = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ a)
M5.Signature.binary_dvd_antisymm : ∀ P Q : M5.BinaryPolynomial, P ∣ Q → Q ∣ P → P = Q
M5.Period.cyclic_dvd_iff_root_pow : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ (AdjoinRoot.root F) ^ N = 1
M5.SignatureCongruence.divisibility_of_quotient_eq : ∀ (D a a' : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (T : ℕ), D ∣ M5.cyclicModulus T → AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) a' → (D ∣ a ↔ D ∣ a')
